title: Finite subfamilies of specified generators near a point
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V and K opens with K contained in V. Let H be an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that its restriction to K is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Let sigma be a specified generating family of H on V, namely an epimorphism from the free sheaf on sigma.I, and let x be a point of K. There exist an open neighbourhood U of x contained in K and a finite subset S of sigma.I such that the free map on S followed by sigma becomes an epimorphism after restriction from V to U. There is no compactness, affineness or quasi-coherence assumption.

proof.text: For x in K, choose finitely many local generators of H on a neighbourhood inside K. The epimorphism from the specified global free sheaf locally lifts them. Each germ of a section of the free sheaf is a finite linear combination of its basis germs: the free sheaf is the filtered colimit of its finite sub-coproducts, and stalks commute with filtered colimits. The finitely many lifts therefore have a common finite support S_x. Their germ identities hold on a common smaller neighbourhood; on that neighbourhood the finite-support map is epi because its image contains every local generator. This is the local lifting argument of Stacks 01B8 and 01BB. No finite presentation, affine localization, or quasi-coherence is used. Work inside K, so all chosen neighbourhoods are contained in K. An empty local generating family permits S empty. If the original index type is empty, its generating epimorphism already forces the target to be zero. There is no x when K is empty. Restriction to slice sites preserves the basis maps and the unit, identifying the local finite-support epimorphism with the displayed overMap morphism. No compactness or choice of a global finite subcover is involved.

theorem exists_finset_generatingSections_near_point
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V K : X.Opens) (hKV : K ≤ V)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [(H.over K).IsFiniteType] (σ : (H.over V).GeneratingSections) (x : K) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hUK : U ≤ K), (x : X) ∈ U ∧ ∃ S : Finset σ.I,
      Epi ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (hUK.trans hKV))).map
          (SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)
            ((↑) : S → σ.I) ≫ σ.π))
